verdict.rationale: Stripe (the parent platform that Terminal is built on) documents an official MCP server enabling AI agents to interact with the Stripe API and knowledge base, and this is confirmed live at docs.stripe.com/mcp. However, the evidence doesn't specify that Terminal-specific in-person payment/reader operations are exposed as MCP tools, so it's unclear how much of Terminal's functionality is agent-accessible via this server. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Terminal-specific APIs (readers, locations, offline payments) are covered by the MCP tool set, and independent/hands-on corroboration of agent usage against Terminal endpoints.
